verdict.rationale: Headless CI testing is a fair axis for a 3D rendering library, but the evidence never documents running three.js headlessly or executing tests in CI against the engine. It shows only browser WebGL/WebGPU renderer usage and npm distribution. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a game developer, tests run headlessly — unit and integration tests of game code execute in CI against the real engine
